summary: The diff implements REQ-10 across the navigation bar (App.tsx) and footer (Footer.tsx). The logo is displayed on the left side of the nav, sized at h-12 (~48px), with brightness/invert handling for both transparent and scrolled states. Clicking the logo scrolls to #home. The footer also includes the logo image. The image source used is '/assets/generated/logo.dim_400x300.png', which matches the processed image filename from the build request. All acceptance criteria appear to be addressed.
